fullPassage: The extraordinary expansion of food production by aquafarming has come with high costs to the environment and human health. As with industrialized agriculture, most commercial aquafarming relies on high energy and chemical inputs, including antibiotics and artificial feeds made from the wastes of poultry processing. Such production practices tend to concentrate toxins in farmed fish, creating a potential health threat to consumers. The discharge from fish farms, which can be equivalent to the sewage from a small city, can pollute nearby natural aquatic ecosystems. Around the tropics, especially tropical Asia, the expansion of commercial shrimp farms is contributing to the loss of highly biodiverse coastal mangrove forests.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ included → including: '항생제를 포함하여'는 전치사로 쓰이는 including이 맞음. included는 수동 과거분사로 이 자리에 부적절.
det.analysis:
✅ ① extraordinary: 원문 일치 (형용사, expansion 수식)
✅ ② relies on: 원문 일치 (3인칭 단수 주어 aquafarming)
✅ ③ concentrate toxins: 원문 일치 (tend to concentrate toxins)
❌ ④ included → including (전치사. '~을 포함하여'에는 including 필요. included는 수동분사로 부적절)
det.tip: including: 전치사 역할 ('~을 포함하여'). included는 수동태 과거분사라 이 자리에서 문법 오류.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② farming fish → farmed fish: 양식된 어류(수동의미)이므로 과거분사 farmed가 맞음. farming fish는 능동분사로 '어류를 양식하는'의 잘못된 의미.
det.analysis:
✅ ① tend to concentrate: 원문 일치 (tend to + 동사원형)
❌ ② farming fish → farmed fish (수동의미. 물고기가 양식되는 것 → 과거분사 farmed)
✅ ③ potential: 형용사 원문 일치
✅ ④ consumers: 명사 원문 일치
det.tip: farmed fish = 양식된 물고기 (수동). farming fish = 물고기를 양식하는 (능동). 수식 대상과 분사 능동/수동 구분.

questions.passage: The extraordinary expansion of food production by aquafarming has come with high costs to the environment and human health. As with industrialized agriculture, most commercial aquafarming relies on high energy and chemical inputs, including antibiotics and artificial feeds made from the wastes of poultry processing. Such production practices tend to concentrate toxins in farmed fish, creating a potential health threat to consumers. The discharge from fish farms, <u>which</u> can be equivalent to the sewage from a small city, can pollute nearby natural aquatic ecosystems. Around the tropics, especially tropical Asia, the expansion of commercial shrimp farms is contributing to the loss of highly biodiverse coastal mangrove forests.

❌ ③ 하수도 시스템: which가 비교 대상(sewage)이지 선행사 아님
